messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Triggered alert: suggestions-service 5xx rate > 2% (p95) for 5m
- Service: optimize-suggestions-service
- Env: prod
- Current: 6.8% (baseline 0.2%)
- Also: p95 latency 1.9s (baseline 180ms)
Dashboard: https://console.redwoodinference.com/internal/dashboards/suggestions-service
Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Suggestions+Service+Runbook

Rafael Mendes: seeing the spike now. anyone aware of recent deploy to suggestions-service?

deploy-bot: Deployed to prod: optimize-suggestions-service @ 3b7f1c9 (PR #18714)
- "Add pagination + cursor-based listing to suggestions API"
- Rolled out: 100%
- Deployer: Connor O'Brien

Connor O'Brien: yep, went out ~3 mins ago on the release train. no issues in canary, but canary traffic is tiny. I can roll back if we want.

Allison Grant: confirming alerts match grafana. 5xx is mostly from GET /suggestions (list). /suggestions/{id} looks ok.

Chloe Martin: checking logs now.

Chloe Martin: quick sample from prod:
```
level=error msg="request failed" route="GET /suggestions" status=500 tenant="tnt_***" err="sql: connection pool exhausted" req_id=0c1b...
level=error msg="db timeout" err="context deadline exceeded" duration_ms=2000
```
This looks like DB pool pressure. Did PR #18714 increase query fanout?

Felix Schneider: #18714 adds cursor pagination but also adds a COUNT query for total rows when `include_total=true` (UI uses it for showing "X suggestions"). That could be expensive on big tenants.

Logan Wright: telemetry side looks normal; no ingestion lag. This is request-time. Also seeing a burst of Console traffic right after deploy (maybe clients refreshing?) but nothing crazy.

Rafael Mendes: is there an easy kill switch? feature flag gating at BFF should prevent some traffic but CS/internal might be hammering it.

Jordan Lee: feature flag suggestions_beta is on for ~11 tenants only. but some of them are large (one enterprise).

Nadia Rahman: do we have query breakdown? if `include_total=true` causes full scan, it could starve connections.

Chloe Martin: tracing shows two queries per request now:
- select page of suggestions (ok)
- select count(*) where filters... (slow)
In slow traces, count is 1.4-2.1s.

Rafael Mendes: ok, impact is limited but still causing 5xx for enabled cohort. suggestion: rollback now, then hotfix to remove total count / make async.

Connor O'Brien: rolling back to previous build (3a1c2f8). ETA 3-4 min.

Talia Benson: for comms: do we need to notify Support/CS? or just keep internal since cohort is tiny.

Rafael Mendes: let’s post in #support-internal once stabilized. also capture for beta weekly checkin.

Allison Grant: :eyes: 5xx peaked at ~9% at 10:12, now trending down slightly but still high.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: optimize-suggestions-service -> 3a1c2f8 (previous prod)

Felix Schneider: I can prep a patch: default `include_total=false` and make UI hide total count for now. We can add a cached estimate later.

Chloe Martin: +1. Or only compute total count if filters are narrow and tenant size below threshold.

Logan Wright: from analytics, UI mainly needs pagination and “hasNext”. total count is nice-to-have. Removing it seems fine for beta.

Rafael Mendes: agree, prefer correctness and stability > count right now.

Allison Grant: monitoring… after rollback, 5xx down to 0.6% and falling.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: optimize-suggestions-service @ 3a1c2f8

incident-bot: Alert resolved: suggestions-service 5xx rate back to normal

Rafael Mendes: marking incident as mitigated via rollback. next steps:
1) Felix/Chloe: hotfix PR to remove total count query / disable include_total from Console.
2) Allison: add a dashboard panel for DB pool saturation / query latency if not already.
3) Connor: update release checklist for this service: canary needs representative tenant traffic (or synthetic load) esp. for list endpoints.
4) Logan/Nadia: confirm if any tenants saw partial data / errors; we should quantify error count and share with PM.

Talia Benson: who’s owner for writeup? I can draft the incident note (timeline, impact, actions) if someone sends me key details.

Rafael Mendes: I’ll drop quick bullets here, you can turn into the note:
- 10:09 deploy PR #18714
- 10:11 5xx alert fired
- root symptom: DB connection pool exhausted due to added count(*) query when include_total=true
- 10:16 rollback started
- 10:19 rollback completed, errors normalized

Jordan Lee: any need to temporarily disable suggestions_beta for that enterprise tenant until hotfix ships? they might refresh again and cause issues on next deploy.

Rafael Mendes: keep enabled; we’re back to stable build. but when hotfix goes out, do staged rollout (25% -> 100%) and watch.

Felix Schneider: ack. I’ll open PR within the hour. will tag ENG-2407/ENG-2410 if relevant.

Chloe Martin: I’ll also add a guard: if db query exceeds 800ms, return without total and log a warning, so we don’t 500 the page.

Allison Grant: FYI we should ensure the alert distinguishes “list endpoint 5xx” vs global. right now it’s global service 5xx.

Logan Wright: will pull numbers for impacted tenants and share in #product + attach to PM-412. we also should make the UI copy less scary on transient errors (currently shows “Something went wrong” without retry hint).

Rafael Mendes: good. closing the loop: please drop PR links + rollout plan in thread when ready.
